proves.claim: nextEligible returns null for an item next would offer a seat of that route, and otherwise the skip code next applies to a held, above-route, gate-queued, re-scoped, claim-waiting or after-chained item.

store.io-board-next.eligible-matches-sel.why: Without this test, status could not count exactly the items next would offer, and a per-item skip moved out of nextEligible would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: nextFor offers each seat the item nextEligible clears and records, for every other item, the skip code and reason nextEligible names, so moving the checks into nextEligible changed no selection.

store.io-board-next.selection-unchanged.why: Without this test, a regression where nextFor and nextEligible disagree on an item's eligibility would pass unnoticed.
